items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 19 October 2026 at 9:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Shallow low pressure developing over France, driving a front into the area tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southeast 3 to 5, becoming south or southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Rain spreads from the east overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 to 5, becoming South or Variable 2 to 4 for a time overnight into Wednesday, but quickly veering west or northwest 5 to 7 by the end of the night. Gradually decreasing west 4 to 6 Wednesday afternoon then 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate Wednesday morning for a time.


##Weather##

Rain clearing eastwards tomorrow night, with further rain then spreading from the west overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
